screen.colonyresourceledger.jobs.title: CITIZEN JOB MONITOR
screen.colonyresourceledger.jobs.coverag: Since tracking began: %s observed Minecraft days
screen.colonyresourceledger.jobs.help: Rolling Minecraft-day periods (1 day = 24,000 ticks). Sampled every 20 ticks, only for loaded citizens in an active colony. Percentage = time in that state / actually observed time. Sleep, /time and offline time do not add artificial duration. JobStatus does not measure productivity: Stuck does not identify the cause. Total starts when tracking was installed, not at the citizen's birth.
screen.colonyresourceledger.title: COLONY RESOURCE OVERVIEW
screen.colonyresourceledger.supply_limit: Partial forecast: limited or cyclic chain
screen.colonyresourceledger.supply_help: Craftable blocks are replaced with their ingredients. Only learned, enabled recipes are used. Estimate excludes tools, fuel, reservations for other requests and delays. Does not start any crafting.
